 Neymar denies rumors of intimate encounter with Vinicius Junior's ex-girlfriend
 By Hoang Nguyen    November 18, 2026 | 03:03 pm PT 
 Get VnExpress first in Google Search 
 See more of the news you trust. Make VnExpress a preferred source to prioritise our updates in your Google search results
 Brazilian football circles were abuzz with speculation that Neymar was getting intimate with Virginia Foncesca, the ex-girlfriend of Real Madrid star Vinicius Junior, but the rumors were shut down by those involved. 
 Neymar Jr. celebrates with Vinicius Jr. after Brazil's match against Scotland in the 2026 World Cup. Photo by Reuters
 According to Brazilian journalist Fabia Oliveira of Metropoles , the Santos star forward allegedly had an intimate encounter with Fonseca, an influencer, TV show host and former partner of Vini Jr.
 The rumors emerged following a private party held on Nov. 6, just days ahead of the Formula 1 Grand Prix in São Paulo. Sources indicated that the exclusive event featured limited attendance and had a strict ban on using of mobile phones to protect the privacy of its high-profile guests.
 Individuals consulted by Oliveira claimed that Fonseca drew significant attention during the event by dancing on top of Neymar while he was on a sofa. The Brazilian star later took a microphone and addressed Fonseca using the nickname "Vivibora." Both of them are said to have consumed lots of alcohol at the party.
 However, these claims have not been independently verified, and the story drew immediate pushback from those involved, according to A Bola .
 Fonseca’s management team issued a press release dismissing the reports as "completely false." The Brazilian influencer also criticized the media tendency to treat speculations about personal lives as undeniable fact when there is no concrete evidence.
 Neymar addressed the controversy via Instagram, denying the rumors and expressing his frustration at constantly finding himself at the center of tabloid gossip regarding his private life.
 "There's a story going around claiming there's a relationship between me and someone else, and I deny it! It's sad that we live in a world where people care about the hype surrounding names more than they care about reality itself," he wrote. "My team has already issued a statement, but I had to step in personally to put an end to this! Greetings to everyone, and now let me play poker in peace".
 Fonseca, 27, previously dated Vini Jr., with the pair parting ways in mid-October. Recently, the influencer confirmed that she has reconciled with singer Zé Felipe, who is the father of her three children.
